title: SEBI Investor Protection Fund (IPF) Guidelines
source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
content: Recognized stock exchanges (NSE, BSE) maintain an Investor Protection Fund (IPF) administered by trustees under SEBI guidelines. IPF compensates retail investors for genuine claims arising out of non-payment or default by a registered stockbroker up to specified limits (such as ₹25 lakh per investor on NSE/BSE). IPF does not compensate for normal market losses resulting from market price fluctuations.
